svg.title: RSS & Feed Integrations / Three Separate Paths
svg.desc: Three RSS/XML feed adapters have distinct scope and access requirements: Comic Book Herald is a non-commercial, allowlist- and confirmation-gated editorial feed; Royal Road is a user-selected story-specific feed; SoundCloud feeds are release polling after credentialed identity resolution.
svg.text: LEMEGETON / MEDIA SYSTEM
RSS & FEED INTEGRATIONS / THREE SEPARATE PATHS
01 / CURRENT FEED ADAPTERS
Comic Book Herald
Manual reference · Feed route
Only the unmodified RSS feed is eligible.
Requires source ID in MEDIA_SOURCE_SCRAPE_ALLOWLIST.
Also requires explicit non-commercial confirmation.
Does not scrape or automate site pages.
Feed response: 512 KiB cap · 10 s timeout · no retries.
Returned item links and source attribution are retained.
Royal Road
Story-specific public RSS · outside 64-source registry
Member supplies a valid fiction ID or supported HTTPS URL.
Uses that fiction's official RSS syndication URL.
Shows story title, author, up to five recent chapter titles/links.
Keeps publication timestamps when provided.
This is not global search, catalogue discovery or trending.
Metadata only; chapter body contents are never fetched.
SoundCloud
Release RSS after API identity resolution
SoundCloud API credentials resolve the artist/user identity.
Tracker polls the user's public sounds.rss feed.
Parser accepts at most five RSS items per request.
Release links must be HTTPS on soundcloud.com.
Guild tracker deduplicates by provider + release ID.
No audio retrieval, download or stream ripping.
02 / FEEDS ARE NOT A GENERIC SCRAPING PERMISSION
Each feed has its own source permission, format, identity and usage boundary. A feed's public availability is not a blanket grant to scrape the matching website.
Comic Book Herald remains manual-reference/conditional; Royal Road requires an explicit story target; SoundCloud feed polling is tied to a validated guild tracker.
LEMEGETON / FEED INTEGRATIONS — V3
